operating_notes.text: Total electricity sold in Q4FY26 was 23,574 MUs compared to 19,066 MUs in Q4FY25; FY26 volumes reached 92,814 MUs.
Board approved re-initiating the monetization process for investment in PTC India Financial Services Ltd (PFS).
CRISIL reaffirmed Crisil A1+ on ₹5,500 Cr bank facilities and ₹300 Cr Commercial Paper; withdrew Crisil AA-/Stable corporate credit rating at company's request.
Board approved setting up a Mineral Exchange through a new wholly owned subsidiary with an equity investment of up to ₹65 Cr.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,897.52 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹105.34 Cr.
PTC India Board approved re-initiating the process to monetize its investment in subsidiary PTC India Financial Services Limited (PFS).
NHPC Limited, as promoter of PTC India Limited, disclosed no encumbrance on its shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY 2025-26.
Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd’s **Satyaprakash Dash** (Company Secretary) declared no encumbrance on PTC India shares for FY 2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
The Board approved incorporating a wholly owned subsidiary for setting up a Mineral Exchange in India with an equity commitment of up to ₹65 Cr.

Necessary regulatory and corporate approvals as required for stake monetization
